comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Just as a note, you cannot take the same quest twice in a row, even if it's being held by a different person. I found this out when I tried to do the Amulet of the Sun quest twice in a row (I pulled it, and a friend did immediately after I reported the quest), only to get a message about "not meeting the requirements". Port resetting or doing another quick quest in-between clears the "buffer", so to speak.

That said, even if this quest is repeatable, the item/eq drop rate may be incredibly small (like Excalibur's 5% 2nd drop), if not outright non-existent.

comments.author: Egw
comments.body: What Guilder said should be the reason why Emma can't take it second time, except port reset doesn't clear the "buffer". You really have to do another quest in between to be able to take it again. Also, I'm not sure this 5% for excal and the other top adv quest rewards applies here (it's adv-specific I think). I'd be tempted to suggest you'll be able to get a second book every time you repeat this quest.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Ah, thank you, Egw. I will keep that in mind for the future. If anybody does find out whether additional cookbooks can drop that easily, please be sure to let us know.
